item.title: Araghchi in a letter to Guterres, UNSC president, and Grossi: Condemn US’s repulsive statement
item.description: New York, IRNA – Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi, following an announcement by the US Department of State offering a reward of up to $20 million for information regarding Iran’s nuclear program, in a letter addressed to the UN secretary-general, the president of the Security Council, and the Director General of the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA), has for a clear response and the condemnation of such announcement.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: IRGC Navy reports blast in third tanker in Hormuz Strait
